status: Expectations written and committed BEFORE the first run. Ground truth states what a correct checker should report, including the hard cases, where the current heuristics are expected to be wrong.
material: Constructed fictional text only. Development and test material: never to be used in a sealed holdout (see lib/engine-candidate/dev-material.js).
scope: source-prep.js only. No model is involved.

cases.purpose: clean control: every expected element, no markers
cases.text:
SYNTHETIC CONSTRUCTED RECORD. Fictional supplier and people. Not a real record.
Supplier-access exception, completed draft.
On 3 May 2026 Corran Tooling requested read access to the drawings portal. The access policy requires a completed security questionnaire before access. The questionnaire was incomplete because section 2 was blank. The exception was approved on 4 May 2026 by the procurement lead because the supplier needed the drawings for an urgent quotation and the access is read-only. Access ends on 31 May 2026.
